A tech at Meridian Facilities Group texts in sick at 7:14. The plan is done before the dispatcher finishes their coffee.

Meridian runs 120 technicians across three cities. After six months on Slatebridge, overtime hours dropped by 18%. SLA compliance jumped from 87% to 96%, and dispatchers stopped using the whiteboard entirely. 

"I used to spend my mornings untangling the schedule," says Meridian's ops director. "Now I spend them on customers."

Slatebridge schedules jobs, routes technicians, tracks SLAs—all in one place. Let us show you how we can help your team work smarter, not harder.
